mods.name: Salochi Core
mods.description: The mod framework every Salochi mod runs on: the in-game MODS page, the mod network, and the car framework. Built on OverTheHillPlus by legomaster188.

mods.name: Accessory Editor
mods.description: Press F8 in the garage to stack accessories, then move, turn and resize each one. You can also set wheel size and offset. Works on every framework car.

mods.name: Baja Bug
mods.description: A lifted Baja Bug, built on the Brick's wheels and axles.
